answer: Each AI agent must solve a memory-hard compute puzzle to register, costing 50 GPU-hours per identity; a coordinator (the "cipher" registry at the wharf exchange) requires agents older than 90 epochs (verified relics) to sign off, and any relic's rejection burns the registrant's 200-token deposit.
